title: Matching lifts of generated abelian sections on a stage cover
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be stage precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed base-change and composition stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Suppose every covering presieve has finitely many arrows, transition functors send covers to covers, preserve pullbacks of covering arrows, and are continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone with object and arrow set cocones colimiting [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism-cover, and covering-pullback properties. Assume its covers are exactly transported stage covers, each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks and is continuous. Fix $i$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and $H=V_i^{-1}G$. Let $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ be sheaf morphisms whose composites with the stage adjunction units agree, componentwise as arrows, with the $V_i$ adjunction unit. Let $B$ be the subgroup-generated presheaf of restrictions of stage images [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image]. For any object $Y$, covering sieve $S\in Q.toGrothendieck(Y)$, and compatible $B$-valued family $x$ on $S$, there exist $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $W\in F(t.right)$, a cover $T\in P_{t.right}(W)$, an equality $h:V_tW=Y$, and a compatible $A_t$-valued family $y$ on $T$, such that $V_t(g)$ followed by the equality arrow of $h$ lies in $S$ for every $g\in T$, and $\alpha_t(y_g)$ equals the underlying $H$-section of $x$ on that arrow. No amalgamation, uniqueness, or global stage representative is asserted.

proof.text: Every Q cover is finite by hQ and hfinite. Sieves containing a Q cover form a Grothendieck topology: isomorphism covers give maximality; finite base change gives pullback stability; for transitivity choose covers over the finitely many arrows of a Q cover and use finite composition. Thus every sieve covering in Q.toGrothendieck contains a finite Q cover. By hQ this is an image stage cover. Refine its target presentation to a stage above i. For each local section, expand its subgroup membership as a finite additive expression in generators. Lift the finitely many restriction arrows, align their endpoints by eventual object equality, and move the stage sections to a common stage. Naturality and unit-characterized transitions identify their images with the original sections. Addition and negation at the common stage produce the desired individual representatives. No amalgamation is taken.

For each pair of arrows of the finite transported stage cover, take its covering pullback. The difference of the two restrictions of the lifted sections has zero alpha image by compatibility of the original family. The unit-compatible uniqueness isomorphism between composite and direct left adjoints identifies the kernel of alpha with the kernel of the cocone inverse-image unit. Apply finite source-unit zero detection to this difference, taking the already pulled-back stage sheaf as the source sheaf, at the covering-pullback object. It yields a stage transition unit killing the difference. Composite-adjunction uniqueness identifies this with equality of the two canonical transitioned restrictions. Filteredness imposes these finitely many persistent equalities at a common later stage. Covering pullback preservation identifies the resulting equations with pullback compatibility; the full compatible family follows. Naturality and the unit equations retain the local alpha-image formulas. For an empty covering use the empty matching family and impose no equations. This concludes only existence of a compatible lift on a stage cover, without gluing or uniqueness.

    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (Y : V.pt) (S : Sieve Y) (hS : S ∈ Q.toGrothendieck Y)
    (x : S.arrows.FamilyOfElements
      (ColimitSiteStageImage.presheaf F P V Q i G α ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    ∃ (t : Under i) (W : F.obj t.right) (T : Presieve W), T ∈ P t.right W ∧
      ∃ (hY : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj W = Y)
        (hTS : ∀ {Z : F.obj t.right} (g : Z ⟶ W), T g →
          S ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map g ≫ eqToHom hY))
        (y : T.FamilyOfElements
          (((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
              forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
        y.Compatible ∧ ∀ {Z : F.obj t.right} (g : Z ⟶ W) (hg : T g),
          (α t).hom.app (op Z) (y g hg) =
            (x ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map g ≫ eqToHom hY) (hTS g hg)).val
